subject: Aligning demo cadence to executive travel window
messages:
From: Sara Li <sara@brightworks.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightWorks Procurement <procurement@brightworks.com>, John Park <john.park@brightworks.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Demo request — limited exec window (VP/CTO)

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you’re well — we’re excited to see Redwood Inference. Quick context: BrightWorks’ VP of Product and our CTO (John) will be in market the week of Nov 16 but they only have a tight window for customer briefings. John has a flight arriving the morning of Nov 17 and will be available roughly 09:30–10:15 PT; our VP can join 09:00–09:30 PT on the same day.

Can we run the standard platform demo but compress it or split into a 20–25 minute exec overview for the VP followed by a 25–30 minute technical deep-dive when John lands? Alternatively, if you can start at 09:15 and then have John slide in at 09:40 that would work.

We’d like to lock a time this week if possible — I attached our exec availability. Also please flag if you need a different team member to lead the tech section in case John’s travel gets delayed.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Li
Head of Product Partnerships
BrightWorks

Attachments: brightworks-exec-availability.ics
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara@brightworks.com>
Cc: BrightWorks Procurement <procurement@brightworks.com>, John Park <john.park@brightworks.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — limited exec window (VP/CTO)

Sara — thanks for the heads up and the calendar file. We can accommodate a condensed flow and have a contingency if John is delayed. Two concrete options that should map cleanly to your window: 

Option A — Split 20/30 (recommended):
- 09:00–09:20 PT: executive overview (VP + product outcomes, high-level economics) — Kimberly leads
- 09:25–09:55 PT: technical deep-dive (CTO joins at 09:30 if possible) — Marcus leads

Option B — Compressed single session (40 min):
- 09:15–09:55 PT: Combined session with a focused 15-min exec overview and 25-min tech deep-dive; we can pause when John joins and recap key technical points.

If John expects to be delayed beyond 09:45 we’ll start the exec portion on time and Marcus can run the tech deep-dive with live demonstration of latency/cost dashboards. I’m attaching a tight agenda (redwood-demo-agenda.pdf) and a draft SOW/estimate note for procurement.

Please tell me which option you prefer and whether you want an explicit Q&A owner (we typically have Product lead for exec Qs and Tech lead for technical Qs). If neither option fits, send two concrete 30–45 minute slots and we’ll make it work.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf; sow-estimate.xlsx
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: coverage plan for BrightWorks demo (FYI)

Kim / Marcus — quick note on coverage: I can cover the executive overview if you want to be on the tech deep-dive, Marcus. Marcus, you should plan to show the model perf charts (latency p50/p95, batching effects) and the dedicated vs hosted routing behavior. If John is delayed we’ll run the 20-min exec + 30-min tech split.

Suggested calendar Triage (all PT):
- Candidate 1: Nov 17, 09:00–09:55 (split 20/35)
- Candidate 2: Nov 17, 09:15–09:55 (compressed 40)
- Candidate 3 (backup): Nov 18, 09:00–09:45

Operational notes:
- Marcus: please have the small test workload ready (5 users, 2s token avg) so we can show end-to-end latency during the deep-dive.
- I’ll build a 2-slide backup to surface fallback routing and SLA options in case procurement pushes on uptime/region constraints.

If you want me to jump on the exec overview call and hand to Marcus for tech, I can do that — saves Kimberly for procurement Qs.

Grace
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara@brightworks.com>
Cc: BrightWorks Procurement <procurement@brightworks.com>, John Park <john.park@brightworks.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — limited exec window (VP/CTO)

Thanks Sara — appreciate the detail. Let’s tentatively lock Candidate 1 (Nov 17, 09:00–09:55 PT, split flow) and we’ll send a calendar invite with two calendar items (exec overview + tech deep-dive) so John can drop into the second block if needed.

Action items for you (procurement signal):
- If procurement needs a formal SOW before the demo, let me know and I’ll route the current draft (sow-estimate.xlsx) to the right legal contacts.
- Please confirm whether John will be on the ground or joining remotely so we set expectations for screen sharing and VPN access for any private endpoints.

We’ll plan to run: 09:00–09:20 PT (exec overview — Kimberly/Grace), 09:25–09:55 PT (tech deep-dive — Marcus). If John is delayed past 09:45 we’ll still do the tech deep-dive and record the short demo clip of model latency for him to review quickly.

I’m attaching the agenda and the SOW estimate. Once you confirm I’ll send the invite and include the join links and a short prep checklist for your team.

Best,
Kimberly

From: Sara Li <sara@brightworks.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightWorks Procurement <procurement@brightworks.com>, John Park <john.park@brightworks.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — limited exec window (VP/CTO)

Kimberly — thanks, that plan works. We’ll go with Candidate 1 (Nov 17, 09:00–09:55 PT) and run the split flow. John will be traveling in but confirmed he can join remotely by 09:35–09:40 PT (he’s on an earlier leg and should be able to hop on). VP will attend the full exec overview. Procurement doesn’t need the final SOW to attend — just the estimate is fine for now.

Please send the calendar invite with separate blocks as proposed and include dial-in/link info. Also please indicate who from Redwood will own the formal follow-up (SOW/next steps) so I can loop procurement accordingly.

Appreciate the quick turn, looking forward to it.

Sara
